Welcome to Sharpness Primary School
2027/28 Intake Visits
If you would like to arrange a tour of our school and find out more about our EYFS offer, please call 01453 811220 or email admin@sharpness.gloucs.sch.uk to book an appointment.
A happy school at the heart of our community.
It is a place where all children feel valued and secure and where we care for and treat each other with respect. A place where education is focused on enjoyment, experience, exploration, enquiry and enthusiasm.
Our dedicated team of staff, governors and volunteers work closely alongside the children to provide a well-structured, exciting curriculum aimed at developing confident and enquiring learners. It is a school in which we all take responsibility for achieving the very best we can, in everything we do.
Thank you for visiting our website. We hope you have enjoyed exploring it and that it was useful and informative. If you would like further information about our school, or would like to arrange a visit, please contact our the office on 01453 811220.
Miss Helen Buckingham
